Copper.headline: Elevated — near the top of its year
Copper.reason: At ₹1,325/kg it sits 100% up its trailing-12-month range (₹1,130–₹1,325), +7% vs its 6-month average, 3-month momentum +9%. Near record 2026 highs on a structural refined-copper deficit; Goldman Sachs sees only a modest decline later in the year. Downside is limited.
Copper.action: Cover essential needs only; wait for a dip before opportunistic buying.

Aluminium.headline: Elevated — near the top of its year
Aluminium.reason: At ₹362/kg it sits 100% up its trailing-12-month range (₹241–₹362), +7% vs its 6-month average, 3-month momentum +2%. Multi-year high; NALCO guides that aluminium may ease into FY27 as alumina softens. A pullback is more likely than a further leg up.
Aluminium.action: Cover essential needs only; wait for a dip before opportunistic buying.
